gaps: No direct air emissions (dust, combustion emissions) are inventoried for the process itself; the diesel combustion is carried by the 'diesel, burned in building machine' dataset.
No disposal of the wall at end of life appears in the table, only the resource correction.

The two resource corrections in the table (-2.12E+3 kg gravel, -1.30E+3 kg sand) are about 11 and 19 % larger in magnitude than the ones visible in the aggregated vector (-1903 and -1070 kg), so the shipped dataset may use a slightly different concrete composition than this column.
